battle.name: 縮頭湖之戰
battle.brief: 紹興元年三月十五日，金元帥左監完顏昌自泰州率萬餘舟入縮頭湖，企圖殲滅水寨抗金的義軍首領張榮。張榮以數十舟迎戰，佯敗棄舟登岸，引金舟逼入淺灘泥陷，再回兵反擊，俘殺完顏昌女婿、萬戶蒲察鹘拔魯等五千餘人。勝負全在舟船與灘塗；卡面配重投石車代表同代兩淮攻城通用的拋石機。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 交戰一方是南宋時期的抗金義軍水軍，首領張榮原為梁山泊漁民，金滅北宋後聚眾數百起義，號「張敵萬」；建炎三年率船隊沿泗水、清河南下，在承州以北鼍潭湖水域以泥拌茭草築起水寨，聚眾萬餘，並與南宋承州守將薛慶取得聯繫，樊梁、白馬、新開三湖之間成了義軍的游擊區。另一方是金朝的淮南軍，由元帥左監完顏昌統一指揮，轄下有萬戶蒲察鹘拔魯所領的女真部眾與大批舟船；同年八月完顏宗弼自江南撤回、經六合縣西調洛陽後，淮南戰線全歸完顏昌節制。南宋官軍在淮東分屬各路節制，岳飛在泰州抗擊金軍之後退保江陰軍，義軍與官軍互為聲援，卻始終不隸屬於同一指揮系統，張榮的舟隊因此既要獨力應戰，也要在官軍主力尚未集結的空白地帶撐住局面。
countriesEn: One belligerent was the anti-Jin insurgent navy of the Southern Song, led by Zhang Rong, a fisherman from the Liangshan Marsh area who, after the Jin destroyed the Northern Song, raised several hundred followers and was nicknamed Zhang Diwan, "Zhang who fears nothing." In 1129 he led his flotilla down the Si River and the Qing River and established a stockade in the waters of Tutan Lake north of Chengzhou, walling it with mud bound together with wild grass, swelling his band to more than ten thousand men and opening contact with Xue Qing, the Song commander at Chengzhou. The Fanliang, Baima and Xinkai lakes then became the insurgents' raiding ground. The other belligerent was the Jin army in Huai River territory, under the unified command of the left vice-commander Wanyan Chang, whose host included the Jurchen troops of the myriad commander Pucha Gebalu and a large fleet of river boats. In August of the same year Wanyan Zongbi was pulled back from the Yangtze, transferred west through Liuhe County to Luoyang, after which the entire Huai River front was placed under Wanyan Chang's orders. The Southern Song regulars in eastern Huai were split among separate regional commands; Yue Fei fought the Jin at Taizhou and then withdrew to Jiangyin, and although the insurgents and the regular troops supported each other, they never belonged to one chain of command. Zhang Rong's war boats therefore had to fight on their own while the Song field army was still scattered and unassembled.
people: 本役宋方主將是張榮。他是梁山泊一帶的漁民，金人破汴之後聚義抗金，人稱「張敵萬」；建炎三年率眾乘船沿泗水、清河南下，駐師鼍潭湖，築水寨、聚眾萬餘，屢在樊梁、白馬、新開三湖間襲擊金軍。建炎四年十一月金軍攻破水寨，他焚燬積聚糧草率眾東退；紹興元年二月退守通州，因通州難以固守再轉入縮頭湖，三月十五日親率數十舟出戰，以佯敗誘敵、再回兵反擊取勝。金方主將是元帥左監完顏昌，他自紹興元年接管淮南戰場，九月克楚州、守將趙立戰死，十一月攻鼍潭湖水寨，紹興元年三月再攻縮頭湖失利。完顏昌的女婿、萬戶蒲察鹘拔魯率部在前，兵敗被俘殺。同一戰線上，還有退保江陰軍的岳飛、與義軍聯絡的承州守將薛慶，以及同年八月被西調洛陽的完顏宗弼。
peopleEn: The Song-side commander of this battle was Zhang Rong. He had been a fisherman around Liangshan Marsh and, after the Jin sacked Bianjing, gathered a band to resist them; in 1129 he took his people downstream by boat along the Si and Qing rivers, settled at Tutan Lake, walled in a stockade, drew tens of thousands of followers and repeatedly raided Jin columns between the Fanliang, Baima and Xinkai lakes. When the Jin broke into his stockade in the eleventh month of 1130, he burned the grain he had amassed and withdrew eastward; in the second month of 1131 he fell back to Tongzhou, and because Tongzhou could not be held he shifted to Suotou Lake, where on the fifteenth day of the third month he took a few dozen boats out to meet the enemy, feigned a repulse to draw the Jin ships into the shallows, and counterattacked. The Jin commander was Wanyan Chang, the left vice-commander who had taken charge of the Huai River front in 1131: he had taken Chuizhou in September, where the Song defender Zhao Li fell in the fighting, and had stormed the Tutan Lake stockade in November. Wanyan Chang's son-in-law, the myriad commander Pucha Gebalu, led the van and was taken and killed. Elsewhere on the same front stood Yue Fei, withdrawing to Jiangyin, Xue Qing, the Chengzhou commander who kept contact with the insurgents, and Wanyan Zongbi, who was transferred west to Luoyang in August of the same year.
kits: 本卡的兵器是配重投石車（Trebuchet），十二世紀初已在歐洲地中海沿岸定型，以長臂末端的配重箱加速，把石彈拋過城牆。要說清楚的是，縮頭湖之役是水戰，史料並無配重投石車參戰的記載，此役真正發揮作用的是舟船與灘塗。義軍一方以漁船改裝的舟艇為主，出戰時只備數十舟；金軍則投入萬餘艘舟船，前鋒僅數艘大船，其後盡是小舟，一旦擱淺便失去衝力。義軍水寨以泥土拌茭草堆砌牆體，兼具阻擋舟艇與遮蔽的雙重作用；糧草屯積於寨中，撤退時可以焚毀以斷敵之念。中國方面的攻城器械以《武經總要》所載拋石車為代表，靠多人牽拉拋竿投射石塊，另有撞竿、飛石、灰炮與木柵拒馬；金軍攻寨與守城同樣倚重這類投石器械，兩軍在兩淮城砦攻防中大量使用的，正是與本卡同一技術譜系的攻城機。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the counterweight trebuchet, a siege engine that had taken shape along the Mediterranean coasts of Europe by the early twelfth century, using a counterweight box at the end of a long arm to accelerate a stone over a city wall. It must be said plainly that the battle of Suotou Lake was a naval action, and no record shows a counterweight trebuchet taking part in it: what decided the day were boats and mud flats. The insurgents fought in craft converted from fishing boats, and took only a few dozen hulls into action, while the Jin committed more than ten thousand boats, with only a few large ships in the van and small craft behind them that lost their momentum the moment they grounded. The insurgent stockades were built of mud bound with wild grass, doing double duty as a barrier against boats and as cover; grain was stored inside them and could be burned on withdrawal to deny the enemy any hope of holding the position. On the Chinese side the classic siege engine was the paoshi che, the stone-thrower recorded in the Wujing Zongyao, in which a group of men haul on throwing poles to launch stones, supported by battering rams, flying stones, lime bombs and wooden palisades and chevaux-de-frise. The Jin relied on the same family of throwing machines both in storming stockades and in defending towns, and the throwing engines used in the great quantity during the fighting for the fortified towns of the two Huai regions are of one and the same technological pedigree as the engine on this card.
tactics: 義軍在縮頭湖前後採用的核心戰術，是水寨游擊加佯敗誘敵。張榮在鼍潭湖與三湖之間反覆襲擊金軍的小股部隊與糧隊，避免與金軍主力在開闊水面硬拼；建炎四年十一月水寨被攻破，他焚糧東退，轉移通州，再退縮頭湖，把保全人馬放在保有基地之前。三月十五日交戰時，他先以數十舟前出接戰，看出金軍只有數艘大船在前、其後皆為小舟，遂令部下避其鋒銳，待湖水方退、舟船轉向之際，佯敗棄舟登岸，誘使金舟追至近岸水淺處；金舟一入淺灘即陷於泥淖，隊形大亂，義軍隨即回兵反擊。金軍這邊則以舟船數量與人數取勝：完顏昌自泰州率萬餘船順流而下，企圖以大船衝撞碾壓義軍，卻不習水戰，士卒一旦棄舟涉水便失去協同；金軍在冬季還曾利用湖面結冰逼近水寨，反映其對江南水網的季節性適應。完顏昌的戰略意圖，是用一次總攻徹底消滅義軍，恢復楚州、泰州一線的糧道控制，而義軍則以一次灘塗伏擊把主動權從對方手中奪回。
tacticsEn: The core method the insurgents used around Suotou Lake was raiding from water stockades combined with feigned retreats to draw the enemy in. Between Tutan Lake and the three lakes, Zhang Rong repeatedly struck Jin detachments and supply columns, refusing to trade blows with the Jin main force on open water; when his stockade was overrun in the eleventh month of 1130 he burned his grain and withdrew east, shifting to Tongzhou and then to Suotou Lake, putting the survival of his men ahead of the holding of his ground. On the fifteenth day of the third month he first took a few dozen boats forward to make contact, saw that the Jin had only a handful of large ships in front with small craft behind, and ordered his men to avoid the sharp edge of the enemy; when the lake water had receded and the ships were turning, he pretended defeat, abandoned the boats and went ashore, luring the Jin vessels to follow him into the shallow water near the bank. Once the Jin ships grounded in the mud their formation collapsed, and the insurgents turned about and counterattacked. The Jin relied on numbers of boats and of men: Wanyan Chang brought more than ten thousand boats down the current from Taizhou hoping to crush the insurgents with the weight of his large ships, but his troops were not trained for river fighting and lost all cohesion the moment they left their boats and waded. In winter the Jin had also used the frozen lake surface to close on the stockades, showing how well they had adapted to the seasonal rhythm of the southern water country. Wanyan Chang's intention was to destroy the insurgents with a single converging blow and restore control of the grain route along Chuizhou and Taizhou; the insurgents answered with an ambush on the mud flats and wrested the initiative away from him.
data: 本役可考的數字：交戰時間為紹興元年三月十五日，即公元1131年3月15日；完顏昌自泰州出動的舟船逾萬艘，張榮一方出戰的舟船僅數十艘；金軍被俘殺者五千餘人，其中包括完顏昌的女婿、萬戶蒲察鹘拔魯。張榮起義之初只聚眾數百人，至建炎三年在鼍潭湖築寨時已達萬餘人；他活動的樊梁、白馬、新開三湖綿延三百餘里，橫亙承州（今江蘇高郵）與楚州（今江蘇淮安）之間。戰役前一年的時間線同樣清楚：建炎四年八月完顏宗弼部西調洛陽，九月完顏昌攻克楚州、楚州守將趙立戰死，十一月金軍攻入鼍潭湖水寨，紹興元年二月張榮退保通州，三月十五日縮頭湖交戰，敗後完顏昌退回楚州、渡淮河以北，張榮乘勝收復泰州。義軍自鼍潭湖經泰州、通州退至縮頭湖，縱貫裡下河近三百里。主要依據為解放軍出版社二〇〇八年版《中國戰典（上）》第七百二十五頁。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked for this battle: the fighting took place on the fifteenth day of the third month of Shaoxing 1, that is 15 March 1131; Wanyan Chang moved out of Taizhou with more than ten thousand boats, while Zhang Rong took only a few dozen hulls into action; five thousand or more Jin troops were captured or killed, among them the myriad commander Pucha Gebalu, Wanyan Chang's son-in-law. When Zhang Rong first raised his banner he had only several hundred followers, but by the time he walled in his stockade at Tutan Lake in 1129 he counted more than ten thousand men; the Fanliang, Baima and Xinkai lakes in which he operated stretch for more than three hundred li, lying between Chengzhou, present-day Gaoyou in Jiangsu, and Chuizhou, present-day Huai'an in the same province. The timeline of the year before is just as clear: in the eighth month of 1130 Wanyan Zongbi's army was transferred west to Luoyang; in September Wanyan Chang took Chuizhou, where its defender Zhao Li fell fighting; in November the Jin forced their way into the Tutan Lake stockade; in the second month of 1131 Zhang Rong fell back to Tongzhou; on the fifteenth day of the third month the battle was fought at Suotou Lake; after the defeat Wanyan Chang withdrew to Chuizhou and north across the Huai River, while Zhang Rong took the recovered city of Taizhou. From Tutan Lake the insurgents moved through Taizhou and Tongzhou to Suotou Lake, a march of nearly three hundred li across the Lixiahe lowland. The main source is the China Combat Handbook, Volume One, published by the PLA Publishing House in 2008, page 725.
cause: 這場水戰是宋金戰爭淮南戰線的收尾之戰。金朝在靖康二年破北宋、扶植偽齊劉豫政權之後，江北的漁民、流民與散兵在梁山泊一帶各自起義，張榮的義軍是其中較有組織的一支；建炎三年金軍攻占揚州、宋廷南遷杭州，北方義軍失去活動空間，張榮率眾南下，在蘇北水網中以水寨為據，長期游擊金軍的糧道與巡邏隊。建炎四年金朝把完顏宗弼自江南撤回，並統一淮南戰場的指揮權，集中兵力掃清淮東的南宋殘部與義軍：完顏昌先取楚州、再攻鼍潭湖水寨，把義軍擠向通州與縮頭湖一帶。對完顏昌而言，縮頭湖義軍像一把插在淮東的刀，只要張榮的水軍基地存在，金軍就不敢抽調舟師放心南渡，糧道也隨時可能遭襲。紹興元年三月湖水尚淺，正是舟船可以活動而義軍尚未退入深處的季節，完顏昌遂集中所有舟船，自泰州直入縮頭湖，企圖一舉掃平。
causeEn: This water battle was the closing action of the Huai River front in the Song-Jin war. After the Jin destroyed the Northern Song in 1127 and installed the puppet Qi regime of Liu Yu, fishermen, refugees and scattered soldiers north of the Yangtze rose in revolt in many places around Liangshan Marsh, and Zhang Rong's insurgents were the most organised of them. When the Jin took Yangzhou in 1129 and the Song court fled south to Lin'an, the northern insurgents lost their room to manoeuvre, so Zhang Rong led his people downriver and, in the water country of northern Jiangsu, used stockades as bases from which to raid Jin supply lines and patrols for years. In 1130 the Jin recalled Wanyan Zongbi from the Yangtze and unified command of the Huai River front, concentrating troops to clear the Southern Song remnants and the insurgents out of eastern Huai: Wanyan Chang first took Chuizhou and then smashed the Tutan Lake stockade, squeezing the insurgents back towards Tongzhou and Suotou Lake. To Wanyan Chang the insurgents at Suotou Lake were a knife stuck in eastern Huai: as long as Zhang Rong's naval base stood, the Jin could not safely strip boats and men away to the south, and the grain road could be cut at any moment. In the third month of 1131 the lake was still shallow, a season when boats could move and when the insurgents had not yet withdrawn into deeper water, so Wanyan Chang concentrated every boat he had, entered Suotou Lake straight from Taizhou, and tried to settle the matter in a single stroke.
impact: 縮頭湖之役的影響，首先落在金軍的攻勢上。完顏昌傾巢而出的舟師在裡下河的水面上折損五千餘人，被迫放棄攻勢、退回楚州渡淮，淮南戰線第一次出現金軍主動收縮的跡象，南宋在兩淮的游擊力量得以喘息與整補。其次，義軍的根據地保住了，張榮的部眾由漁民式的散兵轉為有水寨、有屯糧、有舟隊的抗金武裝，縮頭湖、鼍潭湖一線的水寨與南宋官軍的據點互為犄角；韓世忠在黃天蕩一役即曾與張榮的舟師協同作戰，義軍與官軍的配合由此更為順暢。再次，此役在戰術上留下一個可供後人參考的範例：以小舟對大舟兵，靠的不是射程，而是看準水位的落點，把敵舟引到淺灘陷於泥淖，再回兵反擊，蘇北平原地區的水網地帶因此多了一條以弱制強的思路。日後南宋在兩淮與江面對金作戰，經營舟師、設水寨、爭湖沼的作法，都能在這一役中找到源頭。完顏昌的失利也使金朝淮南戰場的指揮權更集中於他一人，為其後來在金廷的升遷埋下伏筆。
impactEn: The effect of the battle of Suotou Lake first showed in the Jin offensive. Wanyan Chang's entire fleet lost over five thousand men in the waters of the Lixiahe lowland, and he was forced to abandon the attack, fall back to Chuizhou and cross the Huai northwards; for the first time the Jin front in the two Huai regions showed signs of a deliberate contraction, and the Southern Song's raiding strength in the area was given room to recover and refit. Secondly, the insurgent base survived, and Zhang Rong's following changed from scattered fishermen into an anti-Jin force with stockades, stored grain and an organised flotilla; the stockade line from Suotou Lake to Tutan Lake and the Song regular positions supported each other, and Han Shizhong had already fought alongside Zhang Rong's boats at the Battle of Huangtiandang, so the cooperation between insurgents and regulars grew smoother from then on. Thirdly, the battle left a tactical example worth copying: against a large enemy fleet built out of small boats, victory did not come from range but from reading the falling water, drawing the enemy ships onto shoals where they stuck in the mud, and then turning about to strike. The flat water country of northern Jiangsu gained a way of letting the weak defeat the strong. Later Southern Song operations against the Jin on the two Huai rivers and on the Yangtze, with their war boats, their stockades and their contests for the marshes, can all trace their origin back to this engagement. Wanyan Chang's defeat also concentrated command of the Jin's Huai River theatre more tightly in his own hands, a step that would later carry him upward at the Jin court.
result: 結果是金軍完敗。萬餘艘舟船在縮頭湖陷入混亂，前鋒大船擱淺、小舟散亂，完顏昌的女婿、萬戶蒲察鹘拔魯被俘殺，計俘殺金軍五千餘人；完顏昌收拾殘部，退回楚州，渡淮河以北，淮南戰役暫時中止。張榮乘勝收復泰州，義軍得以站穩縮頭湖，重新在水寨之間遊擊的格局中主動出擊，蘇北的抗金鬥爭進入以義軍為骨幹、官軍配合的新階段。這一役留下的不是城池，而是水寨的控制權：楚州、泰州、通州一線的金軍據點仍在，淮東的拉鋸依然長期延續，但主動出擊的籌碼從完顏昌手中轉到了張榮一方。《中國戰典》把縮頭湖之戰列為宋金戰爭的重要水戰，事實上正是因為它以一次近乎完美的灘塗伏擊，扭轉了淮南戰場的攻守之勢；作為個案，它也說明在缺乏騎兵與攻城重器的江南水網地帶，小股舟師照樣可以擊敗大軍。
resultEn: The result was a complete Jin defeat. More than ten thousand boats were thrown into confusion at Suotou Lake, the large ships in the van grounding and the small craft scattering; Wanyan Chang's son-in-law, the myriad commander Pucha Gebalu, was captured and killed, and five thousand or more Jin troops were taken or slain. Wanyan Chang gathered the remnants of his force, withdrew to Chuizhou and crossed the Huai River north, and the Huai River campaign was halted for the time being. Zhang Rong took the recovered city of Taizhou, the insurgents held their ground at Suotou Lake, and the war in northern Jiangsu entered a new stage in which the insurgents formed the backbone and the regular troops supported them. What this battle left behind was not a captured city but control of the stockades: the Jin positions along the Chuizhou, Taizhou and Tongzhou line remained, and the see-saw in eastern Huai continued for years, but the initiative in the attack passed from Wanyan Chang to Zhang Rong. The China Combat Handbook lists the battle of Suotou Lake among the major naval actions of the Song-Jin war, and rightly so, because a near-perfect ambush on the mud flats reversed the balance of the Huai River front; as a case study it also shows that in the southern water country, where cavalry and heavy siege engines were scarce, a small flotilla could still beat a large army.
